summary.en: Markets opened steady with AI and semiconductor stocks leading gains as tech sector continues to show resilience amid mixed macro signals.
summary.zh: 市场开盘平稳，AI 和半导体股领涨，科技板块在宏观信号混杂中继续展现韧性。

title.en: Major AI chip stocks rally on strong demand outlook
title.zh: 主要 AI 芯片股因需求前景强劲而上涨

impact.en: Enterprise AI adoption accelerating; data center expansion plans announced
impact.zh: 企业 AI 采用加速；数据中心扩张计划公布

title.en: Fed officials signal patience on rate cuts despite cooling inflation
title.zh: 联储官员在通胀降温背景下仍对降息持谨慎态度

impact.en: Treasury yields steady; dollar holding firm
impact.zh: 美债收益率平稳；美元指数持稳

ai.en: Positive - Strong earnings expectations drive momentum
ai.zh: 积极 - 强劲的盈利预期推动动能

semiconductor.en: Bullish - Capacity utilization rising; export controls easing slightly
semiconductor.zh: 看涨 - 产能利用率上升；出口管制略有放松

bigTech.en: Steady - Cloud growth stabilizing; AI monetization progressing
bigTech.zh: 平稳 - 云业务增长趋稳；AI 变现进展顺利

energy.en: Mixed - Oil prices fluctuating on geopolitical tensions
energy.zh: 分化 - 油价因地缘政治紧张而波动

ev.en: Neutral - Competition intensifying; battery tech improving
ev.zh: 中性 - 竞争加剧；电池技术改善

market.zh: 风险偏好情绪，选择性买入

keyRisk.en: Fed speech schedule; China trade data this week
keyRisk.zh: 联储官员讲话日程；本周中国贸易数据

note.en: Tech leadership remains intact despite macro uncertainties. AI infrastructure spending continues to be a reliable growth driver.
note.zh: 尽管宏观存在不确定性，科技股的领涨地位依然稳固。AI 基建支出持续成为可靠的增长动力。
